prompt_final: Create ONE high-resolution square photographic contact sheet asset for the P2I industrial business-plan website. Strict 3 by 3 grid of NINE equal square photographs, flush edges, no gutters, no captions, no numbers, no border. Each square must be visually distinct and show only the named stage. Photorealistic documentary industrial photography in a modest clean Ivorian tomato-sauce factory, realistic stainless equipment and safe PPE, no supplier logos. Top left: wide clean small tomato sauce workshop, staff wearing hairnets. Top middle: red fresh tomatoes entering a water washing and sorting belt, not jars. Top right: stainless tomato crusher/pulper with red pulp in food-safe collection, no duplicated washer. Middle left: steam-jacketed stainless cooking kettle with thick tomato sauce, closed utilities, no unsafe behavior. Middle center: piston dosing head dispensing sauce into an open plain premade retort pouch held upright, NO spout and NO bottle. Middle right: industrial heat-sealing station sealing the top edge of the retort pouch, clearly distinct from the dosing station. Bottom left: horizontal food retort autoclave with open unpressurized door and racks of sealed pouches, visibly a pressure-processing chamber, no people near dangerous moving parts. Bottom middle: cooling and leak/weight inspection table with sealed pouches and lab scale, no repeated retort. Bottom right: professional product mockup on a pale neutral background: three standing gusset retort pouches of tomato sauce, opaque laminated packaging with attractive red tomato and green leaf artwork, discreet small P2I logo and only exact French text 'P2I TOMATE', 'SAUCE TOMATE', '400 g'. Top heat seal and tear notch, no plastic cap, no zipper, no glass jars, no metal cans, no bottles. Product mockup is illustrative, not a real brand. Keep all critical equipment and product within its individual tile, no image crosses grid boundaries. Natural bright factory lighting, credible engineering at generic functional illustration level; this is not a precise supplier photograph.
